feat(g19): OPA/Rego controls-as-code — I-21/I-22/I-23/I-25 enforcement

New: policies/banxe_compliance.rego
  Production Rego spec — 6 deny rules mirroring INVARIANTS.md:
  I-22 (L2 policy write), I-21 (identity doc write + devcore push),
  I-23 (emergency stop check), I-25 (ExplanationBundle > £10k),
  SAR submit requires mlro_approved.

New: utils/rego_evaluator.py
  Python enforcement engine — same rules as Rego, no OPA binary required.
  - PolicyInput / PolicyViolation dataclasses
  - evaluate() / evaluate_dict() / is_allowed() API
  - input_from_banxe_result() factory
  - evaluate_via_opa() — OPA REST API client with Python fallback (Sprint 3)

Modified: banxe_aml_orchestrator.py
  Post-decision invariant check after every banxe_assess():
  - All violations logged as CRITICAL events (G-20 structured log)
  - I-25 violation raises RuntimeError (code bug, fail-closed)

New: test_rego_evaluator.py — 25 tests (T-01..T-25), 139/139 total pass

Closes: GAP-REGISTER G-19 (controls-as-code)
Sprint 3: OPA sidecar deploy (G-14) will replace Python fallback
